text:
drew_sales: Anyone free to sync on the Rubicon POC SSO/SCIM/RBAC scope? CISO questionnaire deadline EOW.

kim_g: I can do 10 min now or a deeper sync later. Need to confirm SCIM bulk import limits + delegated admin asks.

anya_se: Happy to join. Reminder: Rubicon expects SAML 2.0 IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows, plus SCIM v2 with delta support.

mike_security: FYI — security questionnaire is here: https://docs.google.com/example-rubicon-sec (see page 3: audit logs, KMS, key rotation). They specifically call out FIPS/HSM.

lee_pm: Pricing note: POC will be on dedicated capacity trial. Sales ops — can we confirm cost floor? @drew_sales we should set expectations.

drew_sales: Looping billing — @jordan_billing any quick guidance on trial rate? Customer expects ~500k tokens/day during POC.

jordan_billing: We can cover up to 200k/day on credits for the trial. Anything above needs a short paid commit. I can send a one-page quote.

anya_se: Technical blocker: their SAML NameID is transient; they want email as subject. We'll need mapping in SSO config UI. Also they want group->role mapping via SCIM role assignments. We support group push but not role mapping UI yet.

kim_g: Workaround: we can use an admin-side mapping script calling our /admin/scim endpoints during the POC. I'll draft an example snippet.

kim_g: ```
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/admin/scim/v2/Groups/{groupId} 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"members":[{"value":"user-123","display":"alex@example.com"}]}'
```

mike_security: Encryption Q: "Do you support BYOK?" — yes via KMS integrations (customer-managed keys). Note for questionnaire: audit logs retained 90 days by default; enterprise retention options available on request.

security_bot: security_scan: SAML metadata validation passed for rubicon-dev-idp (scan id 1769513000). :white_check_mark:

anya_se: Can we confirm domain ownership flow? They require domain verification for tenant isolation during POC. We support DNS TXT verification and can automate issuance of tenant certs after verification.

drew_sales: I'll ask the customer to add the TXT record. @rubicon-admin can you add domain TXT by EOD? :pray:

kim_g: I'll prepare a short runbook for the POC steps: SSO config checklist, SCIM sync cadence, example group->role mapping script, and billing expectations. ETA: tomorrow noon PST.

lee_pm: :thumbsup: Action items — kim -> runbook, jordan -> quote, mike -> security answers, anya -> SSO/SCIM config notes. I'll track in the deal doc.

drew_sales: Thanks all — I'll schedule a 30m tech preflight with Rubicon for tomorrow 11am PT.
